timeRepresentativenessDescription.value: Data collection of the used raw materials, suppliers information, energy consumption, production waste and emissions are all based on the reference year 2023.

descriptionOfRestrictions.value: This EPD is representative for PURAPRESS® & PURAFIT® | Lead Free Silicon Bronze Fittings, a product of SANHA GmbH & Co. KG. The results of this EPD are representative for European Union.

technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: The PURAPRESS® and PURAFIT® system fittings, which are manufactured in Legnica, Poland, are produced from lead free silicon bronze (CW724R) solid bars. The fittings are formed via the following production process: Hot stamping of the raw material pieces; Stripping of excess material and surface impurities; Processing of the final shape: Turning; Milling; Drilling out; (Wire pulling). During the next stage, the fittings are cleaned and assembled by mounting a sealing ring into the fitting. The finished product is then packed in plastic bags and carton boxes.

technologicalApplicability.value: The PURAPRESS® system fittings are suitable for the following installations: Drinking water, heating and cooling, compressed air, rainwater, fire extinguishing systems and technical gases for industry. More applications can be requested on demand. PURAPRESS® fittings are mounted with an Ethyleen Propyleen Dieen Monomeer (EPDM) sealing ring. The PURAFIT® system fittings are suitable for the following installations: Drinking water, heating and cooling, compressed air, rainwater, fire extinguishing systems, sprinkler systems, solar systems  and technical gases for industry. More applications can be requested on demand.
